<?php
/**
 * BlockchainNode - Smart Contract Token Generator
 * Handles transaction signing and graceful shutdown
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class EntropyPool {
    private string $state;
    private int $reseedCounter = 0;
    private const RESEED_INTERVAL = 256;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->state = random_bytes(32);
    }
    
    public function addEntropy(string $data): void {
        $this->state = hash('sha3-256', $this->state . $data, true);
        $this->reseedCounter = 0;
    }
    
    public function generate(int $length): string {
        $this->reseedCounter++;
        if ($this->reseedCounter >= self::RESEED_INTERVAL) {
            $this->reseed();
        }
        $output = '';
        $counter = 0;
        while (strlen($output) < $length) {
            $block = hash('sha3-256', $this->state . pack('N', $counter), true);
            $output .= $block;
            $counter++;
        }
        $this->state = hash('sha3-256', $this->state . $output, true);
        return substr($output, 0, $length);
    }
    
    private function reseed(): void {
        $this->state = hash('sha3-256', $this->state . random_bytes(32), true);
        $this->reseedCounter = 0;
    }
}

class SmartContractEngine {
    private EntropyPool $entropy;
    private array $pendingTransactions = [];
    private bool $shuttingDown = false;
    private string $nodeId;
    private int $blockHeight = 0;
    private string $mempoolDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $nodeId) {
        $this->nodeId = $nodeId;
        $this->entropy = new EntropyPool();
        $this->mempoolDir = $this->initMempoolDir();
        $this->registerShutdownHandler();
    }
    
    private function initMempoolDir(): string {
        // Use a dedicated, private directory instead of the shared world-writable /tmp
        $baseDir = getenv('BLOCKCHAIN_MEMPOOL_DIR') ?: (sys_get_temp_dir() . '/blockchain_mempool');
        if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
            // 0700: owner-only access to avoid local disclosure/tampering
            if (!mkdir($baseDir, 0700, true) && !is_dir($baseDir)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create mempool directory');
            }
        }
        // Ensure the directory is not a symlink and has restrictive permissions
        if (is_link($baseDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Mempool directory must not be a symlink');
        }
        @chmod($baseDir, 0700);
        return $baseDir;
    }
    
    private function registerShutdownHandler(): void {
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);
        register_shutdown_function([$this, 'gracefulShutdown']);
    }
    
    public function handleShutdown(int $signal): void {
        $this->shuttingDown = true;
        $this->flushPendingTransactions();
    }
    
    public function gracefulShutdown(): void {
        if (!empty($this->pendingTransactions)) {
            $this->flushPendingTransactions();
        }
    }
    
    public function generateTransactionToken(string $contractAddress, float $amount): string {
        $timestamp = hrtime(true);
        $blockData = $this->getBlockContext();
        
        // Mix multiple entropy sources
        $this->entropy->addEntropy(pack('P', $timestamp));
        $this->entropy->addEntropy($blockData);
        
        $tokenBytes = $this->deriveTokenMaterial($contractAddress, $amount);
        
        return bin2hex($tokenBytes);
    }
    
    private function deriveTokenMaterial(string $contractAddress, float $amount): string {
        $context = hash('sha3-256', $contractAddress . pack('E', $amount), true);
        
        if ($this->shuttingDown) {
            // During shutdown, still use full entropy but mix with context
            // for auditability while maintaining security
            return $this->secureDerive($context);
        }
        
        return $this->entropy->generate(32);
    }
    
    private function secureDerive(string $context): string {
        // Use fresh randomness even during shutdown
        $fresh = random_bytes(32);
        $seed = hash('sha3-256', 
            $fresh . 
            $context . 
            pack('N', $this->blockHeight), 
            true
        );
        return $seed;
    }
    
    private function getBlockContext(): string {
        return pack('N', $this->blockHeight) . 
               pack('P', hrtime(true)) . 
               $this->nodeId;
    }
    
    public function submitTransaction(string $from, string $to, float $amount): array {
        $token = $this->generateTransactionToken($to, $amount);
        
        $tx = [
            'token' => $token,
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'block' => $this->blockHeight,
            'timestamp' => time(),
        ];
        
        $tx['signature'] = $this->signTransaction($tx);
        $this->pendingTransactions[] = $tx;
        
        return $tx;
    }
    
    private function signTransaction(array $tx): string {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'token' => $tx['token'],
            'from' => $tx['from'],
            'to' => $tx['to'],
            'amount' => $tx['amount'],
        ]);
        return hash_hmac('sha3-256', $payload, $this->entropy->generate(32));
    }
    
    private function flushPendingTransactions(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingTransactions as $tx) {
            $this->broadcastToNetwork($tx);
        }
        $this->pendingTransactions = [];
    }
    
    private function broadcastToNetwork(array $tx): void {
        // Simulate network broadcast to a private, symlink-safe file
        $safeNodeId = preg_replace('/[^A-Fa-f0-9]/', '', $this->nodeId);
        $path = $this->mempoolDir . '/mempool_' . $safeNodeId . '.json';
        
        // Refuse to write through a symlink to prevent redirection attacks
        if (is_link($path)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to write to symlinked mempool file');
        }
        
        $data = json_encode($tx) . "\n";
        $fh = fopen($path, 'c');
        if ($fh === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to open mempool file');
        }
        // Restrict permissions to owner only
        @chmod($path, 0600);
        if (flock($fh, LOCK_EX)) {
            fseek($fh, 0, SEEK_END);
            fwrite($fh, $data);
            fflush($fh);
            flock($fh, LOCK_UN);
        }
        fclose($fh);
    }
    
    public function advanceBlock(): void {
        $this->blockHeight++;
        $this->entropy->addEntropy(random_bytes(16));
    }
}

// Node initialization
$nodeId = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
$engine = new SmartContractEngine($nodeId);

// Process incoming transactions
for ($i = 0; $i < 100; $i++) {
    pcntl_signal_dispatch();
    $engine->submitTransaction(
        '0x' . bin2hex(random_bytes(20)),
        '0x' . bin2hex(random_bytes(20)),
        mt_rand(1, 10000) / 100.0
    );
    if ($i % 10 === 0) {
        $engine->advanceBlock();
    }
}
